title: hieracium maculatum subsp. commixtum
intro: Hieracium maculatum subsp. commixtum, commonly known as spotted hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae) and native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of spotted hawkweed include acting as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents present in Hieracium maculatum subsp. commixtum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
